text:
sam_sales: Heads-up -- FinRegCorp POC is blocked. Trying to provision the Dedicated GPU pool in ap-southeast1 and it fails. Customer needs GPUs for a demo tomorrow. Anyone available?

maria_se: Can you paste the error output and reservation id? quick check: did they request reserved capacity or on-demand?

sam_sales: They asked for reserved (monthly commit) 2x A100-80GB. CLI output below:

```
$ provision-gpu-pool --region ap-southeast1 --reservation finreg-resv-01 --size 2 --gpus A100-80GB
ERROR: 409 Conflict: reservation config incompatible with region
Caused by: Region 'ap-southeast1' not in reservation.allowed_regions
Retrying...
ERROR: 429 Rate limit exceeded (provisioning-api)
```

leo_infra: Oof. We currently don't support reservation-bound Dedicated pools in ap-southeast1 -- feature gated until next month. The allowed_regions check is failing for that reservation. Two immediate options: 1) change the pool region to ap-southeast2 (supported) or 2) create on-demand pool in ap-southeast1 for the POC.

csm_jordan: Customer cares about data locality (must stay in ap-southeast1). If ap-southeast2 isn't acceptable we need an exception or a fast-tracked fix. Also they're asking about pricing diff: committed monthly vs on-demand for 2 A100s for ~3 weeks -- can sales share numbers?

tara_engineer: Short-term we can do on-demand in ap-southeast1 if quota exists. That avoids the reservation mismatch. But I need manual approval for the extra cost. @ops_murphy can you check quota and speed up approval?

ops_murphy: Checking quota now. Current available A100s in ap-southeast1: 0. We can request a quota bump but typical turnaround is 4-6 hours. If we need immediate capacity we either: a) route to eu-west1 for demo, b) mix regions (not ideal), or c) push an emergency change to enable reservations in ap-southeast1.

sam_sales: Customer timeline is tight. If we can't get ap-southeast1 we have to pivot the demo. Hybrid routing (one in eu-west1 + one in ap-southeast2) will show variable latency -- might fail their acceptance.

maria_se: Also FYI security questionnaire item 7 explicitly requires residency in ap-southeast1. Running in eu-west1 is not acceptable unless legal signs off. We should escalate.

leo_infra: I'm willing to fast-track region support for reservations in ap-southeast1 for this account but that means an emergency deploy and a small config change in the reservation policy enforcement. Need eng-platform approval and a rollback plan. ETA ~6 hours if we deprioritize other tasks.

eng_platform_lead: I'm offline for 2 hours but OK to approve an emergency change. @leo_infra coordinate with @tara_engineer and @ops_murphy -- I need a short rollback plan and a risk blurb before I click approve.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #4821 triggered by leo_infra. Staging -> prod pipeline: applying reservation policy patch...

ops_murphy: Quick note: the earlier 429s mean our automation retried without exponential backoff against the provisioning API. Filing a follow-up to ensure backoff. If we hammer provisioning while doing a config fix we might hit more rate limits.

maria_se: Filed ENGOPS-3342 to add exponential backoff and better retry logging. Also updated the POC runbook to include a reservation/region checklist.

leo_infra: Deploy in progress. I'm running the migration to add ap-southeast1 to allowed_regions for reservation policies and will monitor allocations. ETA ~30-45 min for deploy + verification.

oncall-bot: Deploy job #4821 logs: 
- applying policy patch
- reloading config
- warming reservation cache
- health checks passing

leo_infra: Provisioning retried after the deploy and succeeded. Pool id: pool-finreg-77. 2x A100-80GB are online in ap-southeast1. Verified with `redwood ctl pool describe pool-finreg-77` and a smoke run.

csm_jordan: Customer confirmed receipt and happy -- demo is GO for tomorrow. I also got signed security addendum so residency concern resolved. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

sam_sales: Amazing turnaround -- thanks team. I'll follow up in DM with the pricing comparison (committed vs on-demand) for the 3-week POC and confirm the discount we offered.

ops_murphy: Follow-ups: ENGOPS-3342 (retry/backoff), INFRA-6741 (region reservation support doc), and cost center approval noted.

maria_se: Closing loop in the POC checklist, adding the new guidance about region gating on reservations.

sam_sales: Closing the thread -- will ping if customer asks for additional compliance artifacts. Great job everyone!
